assertions.source: family maximum 5.6625615 MeV/nucleon AT m_e vs the empirical B/A plateau 8.5 MeV/nucleon (independent: nuclear data). At E_0 = m_e/(q0(q0-1)) the same maximum is 46.386351 MeV/nucleon and the statement is FALSE.

description: Enumerates every extensive counter the canonical atomic word offers, crossed with every normaliser convention, and measures whether any combination reaches the empirical extensive coefficient. None does.

counter_forms.note: all exactly linear, zero residual over A=2..56; letters is exactly 4x strands

which_counter_is_the_A1_object.why: y_lambda_symbolic takes only n; tr_M = sum_lambda y_lambda * chi^lambda, so the word enters through chi and never through the normaliser. Z(n) is word-independent.
which_counter_is_the_A1_object.correction: An earlier reading of this grid treated all sixteen cells as conventions of one object. They are not. Only the STRANDS row is A1; the other rows are different physical proposals (a per-letter or per-bond energy) with no axiom source. Presenting them together overstated the available freedom and made A1's deficit look like 1.50x when for A1 it is 6.0-8.0x.

SCALE_CORRECTION_2026_08_31.what_survives: The counter measurements. They are dimensionless and read off atom_braid_word_3A: bonds A-1, averaged 2A+1, strands 3A, letters 12A-1, exactly linear, letters = 4 x strands. Both assertions are scale-free. So is the finding that Z(n) is word-independent and A1's counter is therefore strands.
SCALE_CORRECTION_2026_08_31.what_is_withdrawn: Every MeV magnitude, the 'still 1.50x short' framing, and the conclusion that 'the missing factor is neither a normalisation nor a counter' -- at E_0 there is no factor of that size left to explain.

data.verdict: The missing factor is neither a normalisation nor a counter. Every extensive counter the atomic word offers is exactly linear in A with slope in {1,2,3,12}; crossed with every normaliser convention the coefficient spans 0.355..5.663 MeV/nucleon, and the maximum is still 1.50x short of the B/A plateau and 2.79x short of a_V. Both obvious places to look are now enumerated and both come up short. AND the counter is not free for A1: the normaliser Z(n) is word-independent, so the object A1 proposes to stop discarding counts STRANDS, giving 6.0-8.0x. The letter counter (which would give 1.50x) belongs to a DIFFERENT proposal with no axiom source -- crossing the two in one grid, as an earlier reading of this probe did, overstates the freedom and flatters A1.
